changed_behaviour: Annotation responses gain a new errorMessage field on VariantAnnotation objects.
rationale: No checked-in OpenAPI document exists; the new response field cannot be specified.

changed_behaviour: Evaluation result segmentID is now set only for the segment that matched a variant, not the last evaluated segment.
rationale: No contract document; change to segmentID value in evaluation response.

changed_behaviour: Updates to branches protected by a merge queue are no longer rejected with merge-queue rule violations.
rationale: Commit API documents 422 TypesRulesViolations generically; no mention of merge-queue branch-update rule anywhere in contract.

changed_behaviour: Sync-created hook resources now get app-instance tracking per configured method (annotation/label, truncated label) instead of always the plain label.
rationale: Side effect on Kubernetes hook resources during sync; swagger does not describe tracking metadata applied to hooks.

changed_behaviour: Bridge objects gain a websocketConfiguration field accepted on create/update and returned on reads.
rationale: Bridge schema in the contract has no websocketConfiguration property; grep finds no websocket mention.

changed_behaviour: Video stream endpoints default the channel query parameter to 1 instead of 0 when omitted.
rationale: openapi.yaml has no /stream paths; video stream operations are undocumented.

changed_behaviour: Generate-report request now accepts path and build values up to 120 characters instead of 20.
rationale: No contract document; validation size limit change on GenerateDto fields.

changed_behaviour: Saved commands returned for a device are now ordered by description.
rationale: Operation documented, returns array of Command; no ordering stated.

changed_behaviour: Location levels listing accepts include-aliases parameter and may return aliases field on levels.
rationale: No checked-in contract document; new query parameter and response field.

changed_behaviour: Namespaced resources defaulted to the app namespace now get tracking metadata re-applied; normalization error condition message changes.
rationale: Controller comparison change visible in sync status/conditions; swagger silent about tracking normalization or condition messages.

changed_behaviour: Wallet direct_post endpoint now accepts a JARM 'response' JWT form field, verifying its signature; invalid JWT or unparsable form yields 400.
rationale: No contract document; new accepted request format and error handling for wallet response posting.

changed_behaviour: The Accept request header is no longer echoed/written to external response headers.
rationale: Only Kubernetes/Helm deployment files for Swagger UI exist; no API contract. Header handling affects all HTTP operations.

changed_behaviour: Comment page query now decodes a short comment_id parameter, so lookups by short comment ID resolve correctly.
rationale: Operation documented but comment_id query parameter is not listed; contract silent about ID decoding.

changed_behaviour: Deleting a GitHub branch that removes a published workflow's last version now unpublishes the workflow.
rationale: Description says it deletes matching workflow versions; unpublishing side effect is not mentioned.

changed_behaviour: OAuth authorize and OIDC login now return 405 with status failed; /oauth/redirect replaced by /oauth/userinfo; new /oidc/redirect endpoint.
rationale: No checked-in contract; status codes and routes changed for stub OAuth/OIDC endpoints.

changed_behaviour: Batch check results now report a limitation message in the error field when membership is unknown in strict mode.
rationale: error field described only as any error generated while checking; strict-mode limitation reporting not stated.

changed_behaviour: Annotation responses gain a new genomicLocationExplanation field.
rationale: No checked-in OpenAPI document; new response field.

changed_behaviour: Concurrent submodel element create/update/delete/value/file operations are now serialized, avoiding race conditions and lost updates.
rationale: No contract document; change only observable under concurrent requests.

changed_behaviour: Group listing and children endpoints gain subGroupsCount parameter; children now include subGroupCount even with briefRepresentation by default.
rationale: No checked-in contract document at parent commit.

changed_behaviour: Connection create/modify now rejects invalid response-diversion header mappings and specific config with a validation error.
rationale: Contract folder holds only Swagger UI Kubernetes/Helm deployment manifests, no API description.

changed_behaviour: Question page canonical URL omits the title slug also when permalink setting is question-ID-by-short-ID.
rationale: Server-rendered HTML question page; the swagger documents only /answer/api/v1 JSON endpoints, not template routes.

changed_behaviour: Gitspace create accepts code_repo_ref and uses it, not code_repo_url, to resolve internal repos; actions fail when ref is missing.
rationale: Gitspace create documented with code_repo_url only; code_repo_ref and internal repo lookup rule absent.

changed_behaviour: Requests with an unknown HTTP method are now marked handled after the 405 response, so no further handler alters the response.
rationale: No contract document; generic request handler change affecting any path with unsupported method.

changed_behaviour: Artifact and version creation now records the authenticated principal as owner; v2/v3 update-artifact paths gain write authorization check.
rationale: owner/createdBy fields exist only as bare strings; contract does not say they hold the creating principal or state authorization rules.

changed_behaviour: Entra ID sessions with an expired access token now attempt silent token renewal (throttled after failures) instead of keeping the dead token and stale groups.
rationale: Session credential refresh affects permission-filtered results; contract says nothing about token renewal or group refresh.

changed_behaviour: Producer and consumer operations now return 503 'Bridge is overloaded' when the dedicated executor rejects tasks.
rationale: No 503 response or overload behaviour appears anywhere in the bridge OpenAPI document.

changed_behaviour: Attachment upload now fails when multipart file or fileName part is missing.
rationale: No contract document; new required multipart part check.

changed_behaviour: Validation error messages in field error responses are now capitalized and end with a period.
rationale: Applies to all validated requests; contract gives no error message format for form field errors.

changed_behaviour: Cancelling a run with nested reusable workflow callers no longer cancels intermediate callers directly; their re-aggregated status is used.
rationale: Cancel endpoint documented; job status aggregation for reusable workflow callers not described.

changed_behaviour: Get global/subject config falls back to default global compatibility instead of NONE; setting NONE now stores a rule rather than deleting it.
rationale: Config operations documented generically; no default compatibility value or NONE handling stated.

changed_behaviour: Altinn access DTO gains an adressesperreTilganger list, which may appear in responses that expose user access rights.
rationale: No contract document; DTO appears to map an external Altinn response, HTTP exposure uncertain.

changed_behaviour: Project PATCH now renames a project using required name and office query parameters instead of updating from the request body.
rationale: swagger-config.yaml documents locations, timeseries, ratings, levels etc. but no /projects paths.

changed_behaviour: Passkey login completing two-factor no longer also writes the one-factor response, so only one response body is returned.
rationale: Contract gives 200 redirectResponse schema but says nothing about the 2FA passkey branch or duplicate response writes.

changed_behaviour: Project create trims names and rejects names too short after trimming; project rename trims name; manual launches no longer trigger finish notifications.
rationale: No checked-in contract; new trimming/length validation and notification side effect.

changed_behaviour: CORS headers are now set for requests from http://127.0.0.1 origins, like http://localhost.
rationale: Global CORS filter affects all endpoints; swagger has no CORS or origin information.

changed_behaviour: Policy conditions accept EXPRESSION subject with violationType, validate CEL expressions (400 with celErrors), and no longer cap value at 255 chars.
rationale: No checked-in contract document.

changed_behaviour: Settings update key server.footer.links is replaced by server.sidebar.links.
rationale: No contract document; accepted settings key enum changed.

changed_behaviour: Attachment previews are regenerated when the cache read fails, instead of returning no preview.
rationale: preview_size parameter documented but caching/failure behaviour not described; change largely a refactor.

changed_behaviour: Loan schedule disbursement periods now include fee charges due at disbursement instead of ignoring them.
rationale: No contract document; repayment schedule charge amounts change.

changed_behaviour: Product-not-found on review operations now returns 404 instead of 400; type-mismatch/unreadable-body errors no longer map to 500.
spec_quote: Bad request, e.g. the query parameters are invalid or product not found.
rationale: Contract explicitly documents 400 for product not found (also 'Product not found.' under GET review); code now returns 404.

changed_behaviour: New endpoint serves the per-request JARM ephemeral JWKS; client metadata jwks_uri by reference now points to it.
rationale: No checked-in contract document; new route and changed client metadata reference.

changed_behaviour: Password policy failures now return structured validation messages (min length, too similar, too many breaches) instead of generic error text.
rationale: Contracts do not enumerate password validation message IDs or texts; grep finds no breach/similarity wording.

changed_behaviour: Info endpoint response gains annotationSourcesInfo list with source versions.
rationale: No checked-in contract document; new response field.

changed_behaviour: Permission computation is synchronized so parent group permissions are no longer lost under concurrent lookup, affecting role-filtered search results.
rationale: Race-condition fix in session permissions; contract silent about permission computation.

changed_behaviour: Contract sync skips partner entitlements lacking purchase data instead of failing with an error.
rationale: Sync operation documented with 200 StatusResponse only; handling of malformed upstream entitlements not described.

changed_behaviour: Identity import with passkey credentials lacking user_handle or credentials is now rejected with 400.
rationale: user_handle documented as optional property without required constraint; no rejection rule stated.

changed_behaviour: Flag snapshots listing applies a configured default limit when no limit parameter is given.
rationale: No checked-in contract document.

changed_behaviour: Iceberg schema last-column-id computation no longer counts the initial column ID, changing reported last-column-id for some schemas.
rationale: Only OpenAPI document has 'paths: {}' (inferred from annotations); no operation described there.

changed_behaviour: Stale consumers removed by inactivity timeout and deleted consumers are now cleaned up via the close handler without concurrent-modification failures.
rationale: Contract does not describe consumer inactivity timeout cleanup.

changed_behaviour: Process update now returns 404 for unknown IDs up front and fills omitted config fields from the current process instead of defaults.
rationale: Contract describes update as replacement; change makes it merge omitted fields from current config. 404 already documented.

changed_behaviour: Azure AD login moves to MSAL: user ID is the account username and search roles use homeAccountId; expired sessions attempt silent token refresh.
rationale: Change in SSO identity/role derivation affects permission-filtered search; contract says nothing about Azure AD roles.

changed_behaviour: Pagination with page number below 1 or negative size is now clamped instead of failing.
rationale: Only openapi-generator config files exist, no API description; change affects all paged list endpoints.

changed_behaviour: Listing commits with an unknown sha now returns 404 instead of 500.
rationale: No checked-in contract document at parent commit.

changed_behaviour: Implicit subscriptions are now created even when the user already has an inherited subscription from a parent project.
rationale: Contract describes inherited opt-out on unsubscribe only; implicit subscription creation rules not stated.

changed_behaviour: Creating a payment with non-HTTPS return_url on a live account now yields 422 with error code P0920 on return_url.
rationale: 422 documented only for description length example; no P0920 code or live-account HTTPS rule for request return_url.

changed_behaviour: Binding objects gain a routingKey field in service/operation responses.
rationale: Binding schema lists method, qoS, persistent etc. but no routingKey property.

changed_behaviour: Published endpoint descriptors now include path prefix, callback address, subprotocol fields and versioned interface names in href/interface.
rationale: No contract document; descriptors registered with the AAS registry change.

changed_behaviour: Recent time series lookup by tsIds now filters by the office parameter.
rationale: No checked-in contract document.

changed_behaviour: Repository import now returns 400 for empty file, 415 for non-JSON file and 500 on import failure, instead of always 201.
rationale: Only 201 response documented; contract silent on error statuses for empty, non-JSON or failed imports.

changed_behaviour: Stopping scan-all now also halts scheduling of further artifact scans, and stop errors are returned to the caller.
rationale: Contract only says 'Stop scanAll job execution' with 202/400/500; no detail on halting pending artifact scans.
